No HTTP transport, tool registry, or Origin/protocol-version rejection exists anywhere outside tests/e2e/**. (1) server.py's on_list_tools returns [] (TC-016's deliberate empty registry); none of the 9 real tools in mcp/tools/ are wired to on_list_tools/on_call_tool. (2) The container's only entrypoint (infra/serve_stdio.py) speaks stdio only; Server.streamable_http_app() is never constructed/run; docker-compose.yml publishes no port at all (negative control assumes '8080' already exists there). (3) Verified in installed mcp==2.2.0: a missing MCP-Protocol-Version header is NOT rejected by the SDK's own default (defaults to DEFAULT_NEGOTIATED_VERSION); only a present-but-invalid value routes to a rejection path - satisfying 'missing OR invalid rejected 400' needs custom middleware. (4) Origin allowlisting needs explicit TransportSecuritySettings(allowed_origins=...), never constructed anywhere. None of this is fixable from tests/e2e/** (server.py, Dockerfile.serving, docker-compose.yml all outside this card's write_paths, already merged under TC-016/TC-018). No test code written yet since the target contract (port, path, tool-call shapes) isn't established. Recommend a small preparatory card to wire HTTP transport + tool registry + Origin/version middleware before TC-020 is re-attempted.
